tokens.name: primary-normal
tokens.usage: Primary fill: the one main action per view, selected states, slider range. Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, Checkbox, DatePicker, Empty, Field, Progress, RadioGroup, Slider, Switch.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary-normal. Skill 1 decides lighten vs darken so on-primary keeps contrast.

tokens.name: primary-heavy
tokens.usage: Pressed / active fill and primary strokes on soft surfaces. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary-coloured text and icons: links, active tab label. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal and -elevated in both themes. Used by Button.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for primary badges, selected rows and callouts. Pair with primary-text.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-normal, -strong and -heavy. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1 on the brand fill. Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, Checkbox, DatePicker, RadioGroup, Switch.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on secondary-normal. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-normal. Skill 1 picks white or ink, whichever reaches 4.5:1.

tokens.name: secondary-normal
tokens.usage: Secondary brand fill: toggles on, progress, info highlights.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary-coloured text and icons. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal in both themes.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for secondary badges and info callouts. Pair with secondary-text.

tokens.name: accent-normal
tokens.usage: Accent highlight: 'new' markers and featured moments. One per view.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for accent badges. Pair with accent-text.

tokens.name: label-normal
tokens.usage: Default text: body copy, headings, control labels. Used by Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Card, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Empty, Input, Popover, Select, Sheet, Sidebar, Switch, Table, Tabs.

tokens.name: label-strong
tokens.usage: Maximum-emphasis text: display headlines, numbers that must win.

tokens.name: label-neutral
tokens.usage: Slightly quieter body text: descriptions, secondary paragraphs. Used by Card, Popover.

tokens.name: label-alternative
tokens.usage: Supporting text: helper text, metadata, captions. Must reach 4.5:1 on background-normal and -alternative. Used by Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, InputGroup, Progress, Select, Sheet, Table, Tabs.

tokens.name: label-assistive
tokens.usage: Placeholders and tertiary hints, on background-normal / -elevated only. Used by Combobox, Input, Select, Textarea.

tokens.name: label-disable
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons. Intentionally below 4.5:1; always paired with a disabled control. Used by Accordion, DatePicker, Tabs.

tokens.name: background-normal
tokens.usage: Page ground and the default content surface. Used by Avatar, Button, DatePicker, Field, Sidebar, Slider, Switch, Tabs.

tokens.name: background-alternative
tokens.usage: App shells, sidebars and sections that sit behind cards. Used by Sidebar.

tokens.name: background-elevated
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, dialogs, popovers, menus. Steps lighter in dark mode. Used by Alert, AlertDialog, Card, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Popover, Select, Sheet, Sidebar.

tokens.name: fill-normal
tokens.usage: Neutral fill: neutral badges, tracks, secondary button ground, skeletons. Used by Badge, Button.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Hover for fill-normal and pressed neutral controls.

tokens.name: fill-alternative
tokens.usage: Faint fill: hovered rows, quiet button hover, code backgrounds. Used by AlertDialog, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Combobox, DatePicker, Dialog, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, Progress, Select, Skeleton, Slider, Table, Tabs.

tokens.name: thumb-normal
tokens.usage: Ground of moving control thumbs (Switch, Slider): light in both themes so it reads on any track; its edge comes from thumb-shadow.

tokens.name: thumb-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow under control thumbs, giving them an edge against light and coloured tracks.

tokens.name: line-normal
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card borders (no 3:1 requirement). Used by Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Combobox, DropdownMenu, Popover, Select, Separator, Sidebar.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: text fields, unchecked checkboxes and radios. Must reach 3:1 on background-normal. Used by Button, Checkbox, Combobox, Input, InputGroup, RadioGroup, Select, Switch, Tabs, Textarea.

tokens.name: status-positive
tokens.usage: Success text and icons. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for positive badges and success callouts.

tokens.name: status-cautionary
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: status-cautionary-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for cautionary badges and warning callouts.

tokens.name: status-negative
tokens.usage: Error text and icons, destructive outlines. If the brand primary is red, Skill 1 deepens this so error and brand never rely on hue alone. Used by Alert, Badge, Button, Checkbox, Combobox, DropdownMenu, Field, Input, InputGroup, RadioGroup, Select, Switch, Textarea.

tokens.name: status-negative-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for negative badges and error callouts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
